content: True rebellion is not against society; true rebellion is against your own unconsciousness.
author: Osho
sourceWork: The Book of Secrets (Vigyana Bhairava Tantra)
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. From childhood, we are trained to fit in, to smooth over our eccentricities, and to mirror the expectations of those around us. But copying others only buys superficial acceptance at the cost of your own soul.

In Osho's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Your unique perspective and lived contradictions are your greatest offering to the world. The moment you stop performing and stand firmly in your own skin, you command an authority that imitation can never manufacture.
reflectionPrompt: Where does your life require a quiet act of courage from you before this week ends?
